svg.aria-label: AWS multi-AZ web architecture & database failover
svg.title: AWS multi-AZ web architecture & database failover
svg.desc: 1. Edge inspection and routing to the load balancer 2. Fast response from the cache 3. Writing the order and replicating it 4. Primary failure and automatic failover

g.text: The browser sends an HTTPS request
On a cache miss, AWS WAF
The load balancer picks an ECS
Fargate task from the target group
Edge inspection and routing to the load balancer
CloudFront receives the request, and WAF inspects it before it is forwarded to the load balancer
The Order API checks Redis. On a cache hit, it responds without touching the database.
Writing the order and replicating it
The order is written to the primary database and replicated to the standby.
The primary database fails its health checks, so the standby is promoted to writer and traffic
